Lora by Cyreal, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org).
Self-hosted (subset to Latin characters) so the site doesn't send visitors' details to a third-party font service.
Poppins by Indian Type Foundry, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Self-hosted, subset to Latin characters.
Optional fonts for Site settings > Text styles. Each folder holds the font files and its licence (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
Only the fonts you choose are copied to the live website.
  bricolage-grotesque: Bricolage Grotesque by Mathieu Triay
  outfit: Outfit by Rodrigo Fuenzalida
  work-sans: Work Sans by Wei Huang
  instrument-sans: Instrument Sans by Instrument
  crimson-pro: Crimson Pro by Jacques Le Bailly
  ibm-plex-serif: IBM Plex Serif by IBM
  inter: Inter by Rasmus Andersson
